title: dfilter: Add call function immediate instruction
description:
As an optimization add an immediate mode for the CALL_FUNCTION
instruction that takes a single immediate argument and does not
need to build a function call stack.

notes.body: ℹ️ This merge request has multiple commits.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -97,6 +97,8 @@ typedef enum {
 	DFVM_DIVIDE,
 	DFVM_MODULO,
 	DFVM_CALL_FUNCTION,
+	DFVM_CALL_FUNC_IMM,	/* immediate call instruction for functions
+				 * that take one argument only, does not use stack */
 	DFVM_STACK_PUSH,
 	DFVM_STACK_POP,
 	DFVM_NOT_ALL_ZERO,
@@ -116,6 +118,9 @@ typedef struct {
 dfvm_insn_t*
 dfvm_insn_new(dfvm_opcode_t op);
 
+void
+dfvm_insn_replace_op(dfvm_insn_t *insn, dfvm_opcode_t op);
+
 void
 dfvm_insn_free(dfvm_insn_t *insn);

commits_data.title: dfilter: Add call function immediate instruction
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Add call function immediate instruction

As an optimization add an immediate mode for the CALL_FUNCTION
instruction that takes a single immediate argument and does not
need to build a function call stack.

commits_data.title: dfilter: Remove argument count from dfunction call
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Remove argument count from dfunction call

The argument count is implicit in the stack size. Remove the
(unused) arg_count parameter from the dfilter function definition.
